hi_en:रस निष्पत्ति की प्रक्रिया में 'विभ: What is the nature of 'Vibhava' in the process of Rasa Nishpatti?

hi_en:'राग दरबारी' शिवपालगंज गांव की पृष: 'Raag Darbari' is a Sahitya Akademi award-winning satirical novel by Shrilal Shukla on the moral decline of the administrative system and politics of independent India, set in the background of Shivpalganj village.

hi_en:'सरस्वती' में जून 1915 में प्रकाशि: The author of the story 'Usne Kaha Tha' published in 'Saraswati' in June 1915 is Pt. Chandradhar Sharma Guleri. Its immortal characters are Lahna Singh, Subedarni, and Bodha Singh.
hi_en:गुलेरी जी ने केवल 3 कहानियाँ लिखकर: Guleri ji achieved immortality by writing only 3 stories: Sukhmay Jeevan (1911), Buddhu Ka Kanta (1914), Ushe Kaha Tha (1915).

hi_en:जहाँ आपाततः विरोध दिखाई दे किंतु ग: Where there is immediate opposition but after deep consideration there is no real opposition, there is **paradoxical figure of speech**.
hi_en:बिहारीलाल के इस दोहे में काले रंग: In this couplet of Biharilal, the direct opposition of becoming bright (white/pure) by being immersed in black color (black color) has been shown, but the real meaning is for the mind to become sinless by being absorbed in the devotion of Shri Krishna.

hi_en:महादेवी वर्मा रचित इस पंक्ति में त: In this line written by Mahadevi Verma, an analogical comparison of the body with wax and the mind with a lamp has been made through the word 'sa'. Hence here there is Purnopama Alankar.

hi_en:मैथिलीशरण गुप्त रचित 'पंचवटी' की इ: This line of 'Panchavati' written by Maithili Sharan Gupta has soft, sweet alliteration, pleasant alliteration and sweetness that melts the mind, which is a symptom of 'Madhurya Guna'.
hi_en:'रोला' एक सम मात्रिक छंद है जिसके: 'Rola' is an even metered verse with 24 matras in each stanza and a pause at 11 and 13 matras. Couplet is a semi-uniform verse.

hi_en:शांत रस का स्थायी भाव क्या है?: What is the permanent meaning of Shanta Rasa?
hi_en:संसार की असारता और तत्वज्ञान की प्: The permanent feeling of renunciation or mental peace arising from the insignificance of the world and the attainment of Tatvgyan is called 'Nirveda' (Sham), which results in Shanta Rasa.
hi_en:काव्य-गुण के 3 सर्वमान्य भेद: माधु: There are 3 universally accepted types of poetic qualities: Madhurya (in beauty/compassion/calm), Ojas (in brave/raudra/beast), Prasad (in all the rasas that calms and pleases the mind).
hi_en:स्थायी भाव सूची: श्रृंगार = रति; ह: Permanent expressions list: Shringaar = Rati; Humor = laughter; Karun = sorrow; Raudra = anger; Veer = enthusiasm; Terrible = fear; Bibhatsa = Jugupsa; amazing = astonishment; Calm = fearless; Vatsalya = affection; Devotion = devotion to God.
hi_en:“बालधी बिसाल बिकराल ज्वाल-जाल मानो: “Baldhi, bisal, bikrala, like a web of flame, the ooze of darkness has spread to the Lank Lilybe.” What essence has matured in these lines?
hi_en:तुलसीदास रचित 'कवितावली' के लंकादह: In the Lanka Dahan episode of 'Kavitavali' written by Tulsidas, seeing Hanuman ji's huge tail flaming in fire instills immense fear of death and time among the people of Lanka, hence it has a terrible flavor.
hi_en:हिन्दी में संस्कृत के परम्परागत 9: In Hindi, how many new rasas have been added by the later masters to the traditional 9 rasas of Sanskrit and are considered as 11 rasas?
hi_en:संस्कृत में नवरस मान्य थे। परवर्ती: Navaras were valid in Sanskrit. Later Acharyas (Vishwanath, Rupagoswami etc.) added the 10th 'Vatsalya Rasa' (permanent feeling - affection) and the 11th 'Bhakti Rasa' (permanent feeling - love for God). Hence 2 new rasas were added.
hi_en:Malik Muhammad Jayasi is a represe: Malik Muhammad Jayasi is a representative poet of Premashrayi Nirgun Sufi school of poetry, who composed the famous epic 'Padmavat' (1540 AD), 'Akhravat' and 'Aakhri Kalam' in Awadhi language.
hi_en:This famous Sakhi is of Kabir Das,: This famous Sakhi is of Kabir Das, the originator of the Gyanashrayi Nirgun Sant poetry stream, in which he has considered practical love as supreme compared to bookish erudition.
hi_en:Bharatendu Harishchandra, the fath: Bharatendu Harishchandra, the father of modern Hindi literature, in his famous essay/lecture 'Lecture on the Progress of Hindi' had described the progress of the mother tongue as the basic basis of all progress.
hi_en:The author of 'Prithviraj Raso' is: The author of 'Prithviraj Raso' is Chandbardai, who is considered by Acharya Ramchandra Shukla as the first great poet of Hindi and 'Prithviraj Raso' is considered the first epic of Hindi.
hi_en:Acharya Shukla divided the period: Acharya Shukla divided the period into eras: Adikaal (heroic period) = 1050 to 1375; Pre-medieval period (Bhakti period) = 1375 to 1700; Answer: Medieval period (Ritikal) = 1700 to 1900; Modern period = 1900 to 1984.
hi_en:The name 'Adikaal' was given to th: The name 'Adikaal' was given to the initial period by Acharya Hazari Prasad Dwivedi, which was universally accepted. Acharya Shukla called it 'Veergatha Kaal' (primordial period).
hi_en:'Mishrabandhu-Vinod' composed by t: 'Mishrabandhu-Vinod' composed by the Mishrabandhus (Ganeshbihari, Shyamabihari and Shukdevbihari Mishra) was published in four parts (the first three parts in 1913 AD and the fourth part in 1934 AD). The chronicles of about 5,000 poets are compiled in it.
hi_en:Acharya Ramchandra Shukla named th: Acharya Ramchandra Shukla named the post-medieval period as 'Ritikal' on the basis of abundance of epithets and predominance of poetic style.
hi_en:'Godaan' (1936 AD) is a realistic: 'Godaan' (1936 AD) is a realistic novel written by Munshi Premchand, which is called the epic of Indian farmer life. Its main characters are Hori and Dhaniya.
hi_en:The honorific title 'Goswami' (one: The honorific title 'Goswami' (one who controls the senses) is prefixed to the name of Tulsidas, the top poet of Rambhakti poetry stream. He composed the classic epic 'Ramcharitmanas'.
hi_en:Sumitranandan Pant is considered a: Sumitranandan Pant is considered a delicate poet of nature among the four main pillars of Chhayavad (Prasad, Pant, Nirala, Mahadevi). He received the first Hindi Jnanpith Award in 1968 for 'Chidambara'.
hi_en:'Dhruvaswamini' (1933 AD) is Jaish: 'Dhruvaswamini' (1933 AD) is Jaishankar Prasad's last and best historical problem play, in which the question of women's liberation and remarriage has been raised. 'Aadhe-Adhure' is a play by Mohan Rakesh.
hi_en:In view of the spiritual, cultural: In view of the spiritual, cultural and sublime literary flourishing of the Bhakti period, Dr. George Abraham Grierson, in his historical treatise, first called it 'The Golden Age'.
hi_en:'Akashdeep' (1929 AD) is a famous: 'Akashdeep' (1929 AD) is a famous emotional and historical story by Jaishankar Prasad, whose main characters are Champa and Buddhagupta.
hi_en:The name of great poet Vidyapati's: The name of great poet Vidyapati's father was 'Ganapati Thakur', who was a scholar from the court of Mithila king. Since Ganpati Thakur was absent in options (A), (B), (C), the Commission considered (E) as the answer.
hi_en:Among the 84 Siddhas, Sarhapa (Sar: Among the 84 Siddhas, Sarhapa (Sarahpada / Rahulbhadra, 769 AD) is considered to be the first Siddha poet. Mahapandit Rahul Sankrityayan has accepted Sarhapa as the first poet of Hindi.
hi_en:'Vipathaga' (1937 AD) is Agyeya ji: 'Vipathaga' (1937 AD) is Agyeya ji's first story collection. 'Gunda' is the story of Jaishankar Prasad. Agyeya's other famous stories are 'Rose' (Gangrene), 'Sharanadata' and 'Letterbucks'.
hi_en:'Haldighati' (1937–1939) is a very: 'Haldighati' (1937–1939) is a very popular heroic management-oriented poem by Shyamnarayan Pandey based on the bravery of Maharana Pratap. For this he received 'Dev Award'.
hi_en:Babu Balmukund Gupta had written a: Babu Balmukund Gupta had written a sharp satire on the imperialist policies and oppression of the then Viceroy Lord Curzon in the magazine 'Bharat Mitra' under the title 'Shivshambhu's Letters' (1904–1905).
hi_en:The language of intuitive experien: The language of intuitive experiences and symbolic reversals of the Siddhas (84 Siddhas) has been called 'Sandhya Bhasha' (or Sandha Bhasha) by Munidatta and Advayavajra, which means light-dark mixed symbolism.
hi_en:This famous awakening song has bee: This famous awakening song has been taken from Jaishankar Prasad's poetry collection 'Lahar' (1935 AD). There is an excellent coordination of song metaphor and personification in it.
hi_en:'Bharat-Bharati' (1912 AD) is a po: 'Bharat-Bharati' (1912 AD) is a poetic work filled with national sentiments written by Maithilisharan Gupta. Due to the wide influence of this work in the freedom movement, Mahatma Gandhi gave him the title of 'National Poet'.
hi_en:'Ek Ghoont' (1930 AD) is considere: 'Ek Ghoont' (1930 AD) is considered to be the first one-act and symbolic composition of modern Hindi. Prasad ji's completely symbolic allegory is the play 'Kamna' (1927 AD).
hi_en:This famous invocation song is quo: This famous invocation song is quoted from the first act of Bhartendu Harishchandra's original drama 'Bharat Durdasha' (1880 AD), in which India's past glory and current decline has been lamented.
hi_en:'Kurukshetra' (1946 AD) is an epoc: 'Kurukshetra' (1946 AD) is an epoch-making treatise written by national poet Ramdhari Singh 'Dinkar', in which the philosophical analysis of war and peace has been done through the dialogue between Bhishma and Yudhishthir.
hi_en:Goswami Vitthalnath established As: Goswami Vitthalnath established Ashtachhap in 1565 AD by combining 4 disciples of his father Vallabhacharya (Kumbhandas, Surdas, Parmanandadas, Krishnadas) and 4 of his own disciples (Govindaswami, Chhitswami, Chaturbhujdas, Nanddas).
hi_en:Jagdish Chaturvedi was the origina: Jagdish Chaturvedi was the originator of the 'Akavita Movement' that started in the 1960s, and Soumitra Mohan (the famous poet 'Lukman Ali') was its main signatory. Since two options are correct, (D) is correct.
hi_en:Dr. Ramkumar Verma in his book 'Cr: Dr. Ramkumar Verma in his book 'Critical History of Hindi Literature' discussed the Sandhi period and Charan period and considered Swayambhu as the first poet of Hindi.
